title: Fairness Without Harm: An Influence-Guided Active Sampling Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical machine learning algorithm (Fair Influential Sampling) to improve group fairness in standard classifiers (Vision Transformers and MLPs). It evaluates statistical fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity and Equalized Odds, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or general moral/ethical reasoning systems.
